hero: Turn your spending habits into a precise, transparent credit card shortlist.

primary_goal.title: Primary goal
primary_goal.description: Cash back, travel rewards, balance transfer, business spending, credit building, or another goal

monthly_spending.title: Typical monthly spending
monthly_spending.description: Approximate totals and major categories such as groceries, dining, travel, gas, ads, or shipping

fee_preference.title: Annual fee comfort
fee_preference.description: No fee, low fee, mid-range fee, premium fee, or flexible

desired_perks.title: Important perks
desired_perks.description: Examples include no foreign transaction fee, lounge access, protections, intro APR, or transfer partners

credit_band.title: Credit band
credit_band.description: Choose a broad band only: rebuilding, fair, good, very good, excellent, or unsure

card_use.title: Personal or business
card_use.description: Tell us whether this is mainly for personal spending, business spending, or either

welcome.message: Build a quick card profile below, or simply describe what you need in chat. Share only broad financial preferences, never account numbers, card numbers, government IDs, or other sensitive information. You can revise any detail in chat.
